decision: Revert unproven prompt change; target Qwen conditional-preference failure persists and two additional checks fail. Gemma fixes conditional usage but times out on namesake. Single native-default runs do not establish a causal prompt effect.
limits: Twelve pre-existing authored development probes, not held-out accuracy or competitor quality.
Type, source preservation and reference checks do not prove semantic entailment.
Extraction uses native provider defaults; reader/judge settings are not reused.
Saved extraction is structured output, not raw SDK responses; complete model token cost is not measured.
Post-hoc prompt clarification informed by authored failures; not an independent test.
Baseline overlapped other local work; this sequential run cannot establish a causal model-speed improvement.
Native extraction sampling defaults are retained; single runs do not establish a statistical prompt effect.
